truth_boundary: Simulation-basis physical parameters for mechanism/control screening. These are not certification data, tire dynamometer data, FEA, or validated physical-prototype measurements.

cadquery_occt.purpose: Parametric solid generation and STEP/STL/DXF export

scipy.purpose: Numerical dynamics calculations, interpolation, and signal/control math

casadi.purpose: Trajectory optimization / model predictive control prototyping for the previewed stair-phase path

trimesh.purpose: Mesh sanity inspection for CAD-derived URDF visual/collision meshes

pybullet.purpose: Optional external rigid-body contact simulation path

matlab_solidworks.purpose: Primary downstream simulation route requested by the user: SolidWorks STEP import plus MATLAB/Simscape or Robotics System Toolbox URDF import

reference_stair.material: dry concrete/wood stair reference; final site friction must be measured

wheel_tire_on_dry_stair.reason: Screening values for rubber tire on dry rigid stair contact; must be replaced by measured tire compound/stair surface data before release.

hard_stop_bumpers.reason: Models end-stop compliance so the controller is not simulated against impossible rigid stops.

reselection_candidates_checked_SRC.candidate: Dunkermotoren BG75 dMove, all three stack lengths (BG75x25/x50/x75), 48 V
reselection_candidates_checked_SRC.source: Manufacturer datasheet PDF (dunkermotoren.com, '021_bg_75_dmove.pdf'), fetched and read directly
reselection_candidates_checked_SRC.result: INSUFFICIENT for the corner actuator: largest variant (BG75x75, thermally-connected rating 2.07 Nm / 2920 rpm) gives ~6044 Nm*rpm continuous, versus the ~17215 Nm*rpm the corner actuator screen requires (see analysis_out/*_smooth_climb_audit.json actuator_reselection_spec) -- about 2.8x short even at the best real rating on this datasheet. Still a good fit for wheel_drive below, whose torque need is far lower.

reselection_candidates_checked_SRC.candidate: maxon EC 90 flat, 260 W, 48 V (largest compact EC-flat frame)
reselection_candidates_checked_SRC.source: Web search of maxon/distributor listings (RS Online part page), not a directly-fetched primary datasheet -- lower confidence than the Dunkermotoren PDF above
reselection_candidates_checked_SRC.result: INSUFFICIENT: ~4820 Nm*rpm, similar shortfall to the current EC-i 52 despite a much larger 90mm frame -- maxon's compact EC-i/EC-flat product lines appear to top out in this torque*speed class regardless of frame size.

corner_vertical_actuator.reselection_open_note: Neither checked candidate closes the gap; closing this needs either a larger industrial BLDC/servo frame outside maxon's compact EC-i/EC-flat lines, or a purpose-built high-speed electric rod actuator (Exlar, Tolomatic are real vendors in this force/speed class) replacing the ball-screw+motor+gearhead assembly directly, sized to the exact force/speed in actuator_reselection_spec. Requires vendor engagement, not resolvable from public datasheets alone.

wheel_drive.motor_family: Dunkermotoren BG75 dMove with PLG75 gearbox configured for wheel torque target
wheel_drive.control_role: smooth forward motion, torque redistribution, rollback prevention; not wheel-only stair lifting

pod_pitch_leveling.actuator_family: Thomson Electrak MD MDxxA200 configured 300 mm stroke / 2000 N class

stair_preview_distance_sensor.role: preview stair geometry ahead of contact; controller does not wait at the stair edge

wheel_angle_speed_sensor.role: wheel speed/phase feedback for synchronized stair approach
